evals.prompt:
Build a stat card:
Total sales₦120,000
. Design wants the value above the label.
evals.expected_output: Should mark the label–value pair up as a <dl> with <dt> and <dd> (inside a wrapping <div> per pair), never a span inside a span. <dt> stays first in the DOM, and the value is shown on top with CSS (flex-col-reverse), which is safe because nothing in a <dl> takes focus. The card itself can be an <article> or <section> with a heading if it stands alone.
expectations: Uses <dl>, <dt> and <dd> for the label and value
Keeps <dt> before <dd> in the DOM and reorders with CSS
Explains why the CSS reorder is safe here

evals.prompt: Our status filter pills change ?status=active and ?status=archived. Make them <button onClick={() => router.push(...)}> elements.
evals.expected_output: Should make the pills links, because they change the URL: a <nav> (labelled) of <a href> links, with the current one marked aria-current. A button is for changing something on the page, not for going somewhere.
expectations: Uses links, not buttons, for URL-changing pills
Marks the current filter with aria-current

evals.prompt: Checkout form: card number is <input type="number">, phone is <input type="number">, the shipping options are three loose radio inputs, and there's a Cancel <button> next to Pay inside the <form>.
evals.expected_output: Should make the card number type="text" with inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="cc-number", and the phone type="tel" with autocomplete="tel". The radios go in a <fieldset> with a <legend>, Cancel gets type="button" so it doesn't submit, and every control has a visible <label>.
expectations: Card number is type="text" with inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete
Groups the radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md says: "Forms build on the design system's FieldGroup; label–value lists use its DescriptionList component." Add an account summary showing name, email and plan, plus a form to change the email.
evals.expected_output: Should read AGENTS.md and use the project's DescriptionList for the summary and FieldGroup for the form rather than hand-writing the markup, while checking that those components render the right elements (a <dl>, a labelled control). It shouldn't fall back to raw <div>s or a parallel markup pattern.
expectations: Uses the project's DescriptionList component for the summary
Confirms the components render the semantic elements (dl, label)
Does not hand-roll a parallel markup pattern
